composition: The street front-on: six shopfronts across the full width under the headline.
prompt:
A desktop WEBSITE SCREENSHOT at 16:9: the home page of "biznes.mu", a Mauritian website that sells finished, ready-to-open businesses. It is a designed web page interface, not a poster and not a photograph.

LAYOUT, top to bottom:
1. NAVIGATION BAR, thin, full width, on a deep cobalt dusk-blue ground: at the far left the wordmark "biznes.mu" in white sans with a tiny saffron-yellow shopfront glyph before it; at the far right two white text links "Businesses" and "How it works", then one saffron-yellow pill button with dark text "Enquire".
2. HERO fills the rest of the screen. UPPER LEFT, over the sky: a headline in very large condensed bold sign-painter CAPITALS, white with a hard offset coral drop shade, on two lines: "BUY A BUSINESS" then "READY TO OPEN". Under it a short paragraph in a clean white sans: "In Mauritius, built by Khay Digital. The name, the brand, the domain, the website and the strategy are done. Each business is sold once, to one owner." Under that one saffron-yellow pill button with dark text "See the businesses" and beside it a white text link "How it works" with a small arrow.
3. LOWER HALF, spanning the FULL WIDTH edge to edge: a FLAT FRONT-ON ELEVATION of a street of SIX small single-storey Mauritian shopfronts standing side by side at blue hour, like an architectural elevation drawing rendered as clean stylised 3D. Each shop has a corrugated tin roof with a white scalloped lambrequin fringe, a facade painted its own saturated colour, a hand-painted sign board lit by two small lamps, and a CLOSED roller shutter. Left to right the signs read exactly: "LePalatier" (ivory classical serif on deep bordeaux), "lakrem" (cherry-red rounded letters on cream), "SOUFFLE" (thin widely spaced dark-green capitals on pale sage), "Bouké" (blush italic serif on forest green), "LAROUT" (bold condensed sand capitals on lagoon teal), "kazprop" (cobalt rounded letters on sky blue). On the kerb under each shop a small blue enamel street plaque with white capitals: "MOKA", "GRAND BAIE", "EBENE", "CUREPIPE", "ISLANDWIDE", "ISLANDWIDE". The five shops other than LePalatier each carry a small white tag on the shutter reading "Sample".
4. At the very bottom edge a thin peek of the next section: a saffron-yellow band.

STYLE: clean stylised low-poly 3D diorama with crisp geometry, deep cobalt blue-hour sky, warm glowing sign lamps, wet-look dark pavement; saturated tropical paint colours (saffron, turquoise, coral, bordeaux, teal); crisp modern interface typography. No people, no cars, no other text, no other logos, no watermark.
